# Today

Gives the current date in UTC.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Today()
```

## Returns

String. The current date in UTC as a string in the form `yyyy-MM-dd`, with no time, for example `"2024-01-15"`. Never null.

## Remarks

Reads the clock: each call can give a different result.

## Example

`Today()` returns a string such as `"2024-01-15"`.

Effect: non-deterministic. See [Function Effects](/docs/language/functions/function-effects).
